arguments.value: Check whether Router #2 is operating as a true access point/bridge rather than a second router: disable DHCP/NAT on Router #2, give it a static LAN IP on the same subnet as Router #1 but outside Router #1’s DHCP range, and connect Router #1 LAN to Router #2 LAN (not WAN). Also verify only one DHCP server exists and eliminate any double-NAT or IP conflict potential.
